tool_input.content:
%
% Scratch reconstruction of Design 3 (sealing SessionEnd) from
% docs/spec-audit-durability.tex S:design3, for independent evaluator
% verification (mission m-2026-09-20-003). Not part of the deliverable.
%
\documentclass[a4paper,10pt,fleqn]{article}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}

\begin{zed}
ZBOOL ::= ztrue | zfalse
\end{zed}

\begin{axdef}
totalLines : \nat
\where
totalLines = 2
\end{axdef}

\begin{schema}{AuditLineD3}
spooled, sealed, committed : \nat \\
writerExists, hookInstalled, rosterKnown, lostUnwarned : ZBOOL
\where
spooled + sealed + committed \leq totalLines \\
writerExists = zfalse \implies (spooled = 0 \land sealed = 0)
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{InitD3}
AuditLineD3'
\where
spooled' = totalLines \\
sealed' = 0 \\
committed' = 0 \\
writerExists' = ztrue \\
hookInstalled' = ztrue \\
rosterKnown' = ztrue \\
lostUnwarned' = zfalse
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{CommitInWritingCheckoutD3}
\Delta AuditLineD3
\where
writerExists = ztrue \\
hookInstalled = ztrue \\
writerExists' = writerExists \\
hookInstalled' = hookInstalled \\
rosterKnown' = rosterKnown \\
spooled' = 0 \\
sealed' = 0 \\
committed' = committed + spooled + sealed \\
lostUnwarned' = lostUnwarned
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{CommitInWritingCheckoutNoHookD3}
\Xi AuditLineD3
\where
writerExists = ztrue \\
hookInstalled = zfalse
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{CommitInSiblingWorktreeD3}
\Xi AuditLineD3
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{SessionEndD3}
\Delta AuditLineD3
\where
spooled' = 0 \\
sealed' = sealed + spooled \\
committed' = committed \\
writerExists' = writerExists \\
hookInstalled' = hookInstalled \\
rosterKnown' = zfalse \\
lostUnwarned' = lostUnwarned
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{WorktreeRemoveD3}
\Delta AuditLineD3
force\_ : ZBOOL
\where
writerExists = ztrue \\
force\_ = ztrue \lor sealed = 0 \\
writerExists' = zfalse \\
spooled' = 0 \\
sealed' = 0 \\
committed' = committed \\
hookInstalled' = hookInstalled \\
rosterKnown' = rosterKnown \\
(spooled > 0 \lor sealed > 0) \implies lostUnwarned' = ztrue \\
(spooled = 0 \land sealed = 0) \implies lostUnwarned' = lostUnwarned
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{EthosDisableD3}
\Delta AuditLineD3
\where
hookInstalled = ztrue \\
hookInstalled' = zfalse \\
spooled' = spooled \\
sealed' = sealed \\
committed' = committed \\
writerExists' = writerExists \\
rosterKnown' = rosterKnown \\
lostUnwarned' = lostUnwarned
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{SessionPurgeRefuseD3}
\Xi AuditLineD3
\where
spooled > 0 \lor sealed > 0
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{SessionPurgeForceD3}
\Delta AuditLineD3
\where
spooled' = spooled \\
sealed' = sealed \\
committed' = committed \\
writerExists' = writerExists \\
hookInstalled' = hookInstalled \\
rosterKnown' = rosterKnown \\
lostUnwarned' = lostUnwarned
\end{schema}

\end{document}
